newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia's phosphate company increases sales.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia's phosphate company increases sales.

text.p: Phosphate sales in the Tunisian state-run Compagnie des Phosphates de Gafsa (CPG) rose by 6.6 pecent in the first quarter of of 1997 compared to the same period in 1996, the official TAP news agency said on Tuesday.
Ore sales of CPG rose to 1.77 million tonnes during the first three months in 1997, from 1.66 million tonnes in the same period last year, TAP said.
CPG's exports increased 39.1 percent to 308,000 tonnes of phosphate during the first three months of 1997 compared to 221,000 tonnes in the same period of the year before, it added.
The all production of CPG averaged six million tonnes by year in the past 10 years.
The companie des Phosphates, based in the southern town of Gafsa, has a 284 million dinars capital.
